title: AiBatch
description: ai.batch@1: a batch of many prompts on OpenVibe.AI (POST /api/v1/batches, GET /api/v1/batches, GET /api/v1/batches/:id). The answers are not waited for: the batch is queued, and the batch says where it stands. A batch is billed at half the retail price through Billing like every other request; the batch table is the queue and the status, never a second ledger. The owner of the batch is the account that pays for it: a person, a developer app's project, or a first-party service with the ai.batches.create grant (the network's own account).

status.description: queued (asked for), running (items are being answered), succeeded, failed (an item failed), expired (the deadline passed with nothing answered), cancelled (the caller cancelled it).

project_id.description: The developer app's project, when an app owns the batch.

item_count.description: How many prompts the batch carries.

items.description: The items, in order. The list of batches answers with the same objects and no items (an empty array): the items come from GET /api/v1/batches/:id.

discount.description: The share of the retail card the customer is charged, as a decimal fraction of a million (500000 = half).

deadline_at.description: When the batch stops waiting: the deadline the caller asked for (1 to 72 hours).

absorbed_nano_usd.description: What the network absorbed for this batch, in nano-USD, as a string.

ran_on_regular_capacity.description: The batch ran on the ordinary capacity (not on free or community capacity): it cost the network more than the customer paid, and the difference is the absorbed amount.
